content.v: Avalanche Software为《霍格沃茨之遗》推送了DLSS5更新补丁。外媒Dsogaming对其做了基准性能测试，并截取大量画面对比截图。DLSS5能否给《霍格沃茨之遗》带来颠覆性改变？让我们一探究竟。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793916546_730823_jpg_r.jpg
本次DLSS5测试硬件平台：AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 处理器、32GB DDR5‑6000 内存、NVIDIA RTX5090 显卡，系统为64位Win10，驱动版本是NVIDIA Game Ready 621.14。可以明显看出，相比DLSS5发布宣传片，开发商对游戏内DLSS5实际效果做了大幅削弱，仅带来细微的画面变化。
最后两组场景中，DLSS5完全没有带来画质提升，但性能开销却明显上涨。关闭DLSS5之后地面纹理反而更加锐利。甚至前三组对比画面里，开启DLSS5之后草地的环境光遮蔽(AO)效果反而变差，而DLSS5本应强化AO，而非使其劣化。唯一可取之处是主角的外套与毛发质感得到改善。绝大多数对比截图中，主角面部仅有微弱的画质提升。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793916546_268411_jpg_r.jpg
开启DLSS5还会带来不小的性能损耗。《霍格沃茨之遗》是一款CPU瓶颈向游戏，我选取两个代表性场景做跑分：霍格莫德村(CPU瓶颈场景)、游戏开场(GPU瓶颈场景)。4K分辨率、画质全最高并开启光追。
霍格莫德村：DLSS质量模式原生 123 帧。开启DLSS5后降到98帧，性能下跌20%。开场GPU压力场景：不开启DLSS5为173帧，开启DLSS5后跌至100帧，性能暴跌 42%。
Dsogaming对《霍格沃茨之遗》DLSS5的总体看法是其仅带来细微画质进步，却要付出高昂性能代价。和第三方DLSS5 Mod带来的蜕变级画面相比差距甚远。DLSS5本可以彻底改变PC游戏画面，但放到《霍格沃茨之遗》中，仅仅只是微小改善。

content.v: 《塞尔达：时之笛 重制版》刚登陆Switch2主机，而NS2模拟器Lichii已能在PC上启动并运行这款游戏。目前只有部分Lichii衍生分支版本可运行本作，官方原版Lichii尚且无法正常运行。现阶段游戏距离完整可玩还差很远，还存在大量严重画面BUG：开放世界场景会出现画面闪烁、图像伪影、泛光渲染异常。只有德库大树(Great Deku Tree)区域运行状态相对尚可。
油管主reznoire放出演示视频，硬件配置为i9‑14900K + RTX4090，展示德库大树关卡。博主未说明使用的具体分支版本。视频可见模拟器未能充分调用CPU与显卡性能，这套高端PC运行该作仅能跑到40帧。
另一段来自Finn Benchmarks的测试视频，使用Selevet分支版本，硬件为R7 9800X3D搭配RTX5080，在德库大树场景下可以达到60帧。
在此建议普通用户再等待数周，等待Lichii主版本加入对本作的适配。即便如此，一款刚发售的Switch2新作能在模拟器上成功启动，这件事本身令人惊叹。不排除任天堂会效仿当年处理Yuzu模拟器的做法，对该模拟器采取下架行动。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793915648_846031_jpg_r.jpg
值得一提的是，Eglantine与Lichii两款模拟器已经可以启动多款Switch2游戏，包括《咚奇刚：蕉力全开》和《马力欧卡丁车世界》。

content.v: 《 最终幻想7 》重制版制作人北濑佳范近日谈到系列电视化设想，希望未来出现受《最终幻想》故事启发的新游戏或电视系列。他认为，这一方向并非没有实现的可能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793914296_792621_jpg_r.jpg
北濑佳范表示，团队制作《最终幻想7：重制版》时，对游戏世界进行了比原版更深入的探索。不过目前没有具体剧集名称、制作团队、播出平台或开发进度，SE也尚未正式确认电视项目。
《最终幻想》此前已进行过多次跨媒体尝试，包括2001年的CG电影《最终幻想：灵魂深处》、延续《最终幻想7》故事的《最终幻想7：圣子降临》，以及围绕《最终幻想15》推出的前传动画和电影《最终幻想15：王者之剑》。其中，《最终幻想15：王者之剑》限量院线发行时取得650万美元票房，肖恩·宾、亚伦·保尔等演员参与演出。
游戏方面，《最终幻想7》重制三部曲计划由2027年推出的《最终幻想7：启示》收尾。该作将从游戏开始阶段提供困难模式，克劳德一行也将继续对抗萨菲罗斯的行动。

content.v: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的三维化开发比任天堂预想中更加复杂，游戏未能按原计划于1997年末推出，最终延期至1998年11月。整个制作过程历时约两年半，在当时属于异常漫长的开发周期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793913661_119516_jpg_r.jpg
《超级马力欧64》推出后，任天堂将该团队的大量人才调往塞尔达系列，希望推动另一项核心品牌进入三维时代。不过，构建三维开放世界、实现视角锁定和昼夜循环等工作的复杂程度超出预期，项目规模也随之扩大。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793913662_377633_jpg_r.jpg
岩田聪回忆，开发人员面对延期并非只有挫败，有时还会因为获得额外时间而欢呼。增加的每个月都可以用于加入新机制、打磨迷宫并改善游玩体验，但他也承认，如果开发无限拖延，团队士气最终仍会受到影响。
宫本茂将这次开发形容为一场难以估算成本和最终规模的探索。当时业界缺少成熟的三维冒险游戏范本，预算负责人即使能够判断资金流向，也无法保证作品是否有趣。这篇回顾认为，这个一度如“无底洞”般消耗时间和资源的项目，最终为后来的三维冒险设计奠定了重要基础。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Take Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick回应了《GTA6》可能面临的盗版问题。他将盗版视为娱乐行业的“生活现实”，但表示公司并非对此毫不在意；若其演变为实际风险，Take Two将采取法律和技术手段。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261029/1793220250_133679_jpg_r.jpg
Zelnick在WSJ Tech访谈中表示，盗版并非游戏行业独有。他结合自己参与电影和唱片业务的经历称，电影业务过去曾估计任一时期约有10%至20%的内容遭到盗版；在他看来，唱片市场的盗版比例到2000年代中期一度可能高达80%，此后又明显回落。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793911083_351655_jpg_r.jpg
对于现代游戏，Zelnick认为，硬件条件、庞大的文件体积，以及让盗版版本正常运行的难度，都能自然削弱部分非法传播。不过，这些门槛并不能彻底阻止盗版。他同时表示，自己会担忧电子游戏和娱乐业务的各个方面。
一项非官方《给他爱5》多人平台此前已经关闭。Take Two对《GTA6》现阶段态度则是继续关注风险，并在确有必要时像其他企业一样，通过法律与技术措施处理盗版问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 育碧为《 刺客信条：英灵殿 》推出“呼声最高的更新”，加入玩家要求已久的新游戏+模式，同时新增储藏箱并扩展角色成长系统。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793913344_364280_jpg_r.jpg
玩家完成汉普顿郡地区最后一个任务“圣日”后，便可重新开始维京旅程，该节点位于游戏真正结局之前。新游戏+每轮都会进一步提高难度；安装更新后，玩家还需再次保存游戏，相关选项才会解锁。
配合新模式，装备强化上限从13级提高至27级，升级需要消耗新增的秘银资源。扩展成长模式也进一步细化战力计算：装备升级和符文各增加1点战力，专精每投入5个技能点提升一次战力，以增强装备对角色成长的影响并提高挑战强度。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793913932_577063.jpg
符文可使用秘银升级至新的“卓越”级别。符文熔炉的铭刻页面新增超过300种可铭刻符文，覆盖游戏发售后加入的特效，包括DLC和Helix商店内容。雷文斯索普还新增储藏箱，可用于存放背包中的装备和符文。
本次更新新增两项成就，分别要求完全强化神圣装备和完成新游戏+。PS5 Pro版获得PSSR优化，用于增强4K图像质量，质量模式可达到60FPS，并支持PSSR 2。补丁还调整了双持手感、属性符文、技能专精及加成。

content.v: 澳大利亚第21届CHOICE Awards将PlayStation列入“Hall of Shame”，并向其颁发2026年“Shonky Award”。这项负面评价针对PlayStation取消实体媒体的决定，以及数字游戏采用可撤销许可的规则。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793912561_673823_jpg_r.jpg
PlayStation此前向用户发送信息，提醒其购买的数字游戏属于可以撤销的许可。奖项方认为，消费者虽然为游戏付费，数字内容的控制权却仍掌握在Sony手中，这种体验更接近租用，而非永久持有作品。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261106/1793913846_399614_jpg_r.jpg
实体媒体的变化也会影响二手游戏流通。部分玩家会购买二手光盘，在通关后转售，再用所得资金购买其他游戏；如果实体版本退出，这套购买、转售和资金回收机制也将受到冲击。
PlayStation在2026年的利润和营收表现依然出色，并继续处于主流游戏机市场的领先位置。不过，实体媒体决定及数字所有权表态已令其品牌声誉面临反弹，并引发玩家请愿，要求保留实体游戏。此次奖项评价的是消费者权益与产品所有权政策，并非PlayStation的经营成绩。

items.title: Sam Altman 对他的 DRAM 评论被“断章取义”感到恼火
items.summary: Him being annoyed has not made DRAM cheaper, however.

content.v: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said on a recent podcast that "from a global allocation perspective, actually it's quite terrible to have everyone have a bunch of the world's limited supply of DRAM sitting in their own computer, and be used 5% of the time."

Altman was talking about people running AI models locally rather than relying on data centers, which allow RAM usage to be maxed out in this "very supply-constrained environment." What many heard and responded to—PC gamers in particular—was resentment directed at those of us who don't run AI companies, but would still like to have and use our own personal computers, as a treat.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UaujCRuojXkE2oHPcFciET-1920-80.png

In an exchange on X this week, Altman said that his remark was "taken out of context" and that he actually wants "the world to have tons of memory and people to put as much as they want in their computers."
"I have been arguing for the world to ramp up memory production for a long time," Altman said.

Altman's argument for increased memory production is no consolation to the tech enthusiasts and gamers who've been priced out of new hardware by his company and the rest of the AI industry. What we've been calling the RAMpocalypse hasn't just affected high-end PCs, either: In the lead-up to GTA 6's console launch, a PlayStation Pro is $900, if you can even find one.

The bitter reaction to Altman's comment also comes from concerns that big tech companies want to push gamers off of local hardware so that they can rent us cloud computing. For an audience that's already disgruntled about the erosion of game ownership , the thought of losing control over our own hardware is not palatable, however much cloud streaming services like Nvidia's GeForce Now have improved.

That concern is now coupled with the generative AI-heavy future that tech leaders are pushing. If generative AI is best delivered as a cloud service, and the games industry is going to increasingly incorporate generative AI into games, it follows that we will be pushed toward cloud computing.

Nvidia DLSS pioneer Bryan Catanzaro made a comment to that effect at a GDC panel I attended earlier this year. Speaking about hypothetical games built with AI "world models," Catanzaro noted that we probably won't run those models locally, because "AI is fundamentally much more efficient in the cloud."

Ahead of the annual Mass Effect holiday of N7 Day on November 7, EA is promoting Mass Effect via posts about what fans can buy on the BioWare Gear Store. A lot of people online are saying this is tone deaf and gross behavior.

The BioWare Gear Store's social media presence came back to life after a month of darkness today to start hawking Mass Effect merch. The post that kicked things off is the one below, in which fans are invited to "celebrate the legacy" of Mass Effect by giving EA money.
EA followed the post up with eight more, pushing people to visit the BioWare Gear Store to buy things like mugs, tote bags, clothing, and shoes, among other things.
The replies under every one of the posts call out how cold and gross it is to promote the brand so soon after cancelling Mass Effect 5 and closing BioWare.

EA made the drastic changes as part of a big organizational shift and wider pullback that also included layoffs and other game cancellations, like a new The Sims game. These moves came after EA was taken private by an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund in a deal that included billions of debt.
It subsequently was reported that EA chose to pursue a new Star Wars Battlefront game over funding the next Mass Effect and BioWare's continued operation.
A Change.org petition to "save Mass Effect" has drawn 300,000+ signatures, and Canadians are rallying their lawmakers to step in and fund the continued future of BioWare.

items.summary: GOG is old enough to drink in the UK. To celebrate that milestone, the DRM-free storefront — which lets player

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/05/road-rash-1793893660408.jpg

GOG is old enough to drink in the UK. To celebrate that milestone, the DRM-free storefront — which lets players do what they want to games once they own them, including sending them to other PCs, backing them up to hard drives, and even burning them onto discs to add to a physical collection — has announced a range of surprises.

The company is currently on a mission to keep games available to play even after the seasons end and servers close down. Its GOG Patrons initiative has saved 300 old games, funding them to be made compatible with modern operating systems. Over 10,000 patrons have signed up to help. The latest game to benefit from this was Nox, the action RPG developed and published by Westwood Studios and EA back in 2000.

“We dig deep into the code, fixing long-lasting bugs, adjusting screen resolutions, adding controller support, missing cutscenes and much, much more,” said Marcin Paczynski, senior business development manager.
GOG has made over 1,700 fixes to old games in its preservation program. Next up, there’s good news for classic space sim and Mark Hamill fans.

The Wing Commander series — Wing Commander 1-4 games, Prophecy Gold, and Privateer 2 — is getting an anniversary edition update. GOG collaborated with modders for Prophecy, with a goal of making the game more approachable, adding controller support to offer a new way to play.

Each of these games comes with the legacy version and the touched up Anniversary Edition. For people who already own the original games on GOG, the Anniversary Editions are free to download at launch.

Ahead of those updated space sims, there’s something new on GOG right now: Road Rash. The violent motorbike racing classic got the same treatment as Wing Commander, making it compatible with modern systems and control inputs.

GOG also announced Retro Vibe, a publishing arm focused on “new games with a classic soul.” Retro Vibe releases include a VHS-fuzzed FPS with Max Payne-esque bullet time called Cop Bastard, a side-scrolling shooter with tough boss battles called The Looter, tactical cyberpunk RPG Shardpunk 2, boomer shooter with massive boomsticks Project Warlock: Lost Chapters, and the mysterious greyscale indie game After Hell Freezes Over.

You can Wishlist the full lineup of games and check them out in more detail on GOG.com . It’s a site GOG is hoping you’ll spend more time on anyway, as the service is also introducing GOG Social, a new gaming forum integrated with your game library, allowing you to tag games in posts, taking readers directly to the store page. The forum has marked spoilers, threaded replies, reactions, post edits, media support, bookmarks, topic subscriptions, and more.

Lastly, GOG Galaxy — GOG’s launcher that lets you combine your entire library from different stores into one space — is also coming to Linux. It’s landing with new customization and personalization options. Watch the entire showcase on the GOG YouTube channel .

items.title: 温迪的角色扮演游戏 WendyQuest 为击败 Boss 战斗提供真正的食物奖励
items.summary: Wendy’s has gone full Wendy’s, releasing a 15-hour RPG based on the fast-food chain’s branding.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/05/wendyquestfood-1793905186138.jpg
Wendy’s has gone full Wendy’s, releasing a 15-hour RPG based on the fast-food chain’s branding.
We were caught off guard by trailers showing some genuinely compelling turn-based gameplay , but the full launch of WendyQuest has brought yet another surprise: real rewards for beating bosses.

Every time you defeat a Mech Boss, the game will reward you with one 'Corner Stone,' which comes with a unique code. Enter the code into the 'Offers' tab on the Wendy’s app, and you’ll get a chance to win one of the following food rewards:
WendyQuest food rewards
There are five Mech Bosses in the game, which gives you a total of five chances to score one of the rewards. Unfortunately, repeat encounters don’t appear to net additional codes.

The rewards aren’t entirely free — to actually redeem them, you’ll have to make a "separate qualifying purchase." Classic, I know. Reward eligibility is limited to U.S. residents who are 18 and older, and players have seven days after redeeming a code in-app to complete an order before it expires.

The real-life rewards will endure "while supplies last," indicating the promotion may be time-limited. It would be kind of wild if it was a permanent fixture of the Wendy’s brand, but you never know. The company just released their third-quarter financials , reporting a 7.6% decline in U.S. systemwide sales and 5.3% decline in same-restaurant sales, and has been going all-in on the marketing stunts to try and make up some ground.

WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones launched as a free-to-play game on Steam, Android, and iOS devices on November 4, hitting a peak player count of just shy of 400 on Steam. Launching at the same time as the Ocarina of Time remake was an interesting choice, to say the least, and makes WendyQuest one of the few games releasing in the month of GTA 6 .
I can’t believe you guys made a retro RPG called WendyQuest that you can download now. Oh wait that was us. https://t.co/gEiQZ5P1P4

The full RPG includes around 15 hours of content, equivalent to recent AAA releases like Marvel's Wolverine. You control the red-haired Wendy, recruiting allies to stop the evil Mech Corp and save the land of Savoria.

The Mech Corp empire, under the control of Dr. MechBorg, runs with a capital 'M' logo and is all about cutting corners to earn billions, likely a direct hit at a classic Wendy’s competitor, McDonald’s. In-game abilities and items are all based on classic Wendy’s food items, with unique damage types like "Crispy," "Frosty," and "Fresh Beef."

WendyQuest was developed in collaboration with 81monkeys, a Canadian-based company, based on the 2D style of turn-based JRPG classics like Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy. As more and more games launch with full AI use disclosures, the WendyQuest Steam listing proudly proclaims the game as "100% fresh and 100% human made."
Will a solid RPG experience inspire people to eat more Wendy’s? We’ll have to see.

items.title: EA 在 Steam 上发布了大量经典游戏，其中 7 款是重制版
items.summary: The remasters are also coming to GOG (which already had the re-released originals).

content.v: Last month we got news that Wing Commander 3 , the FMV space-combat sim with perhaps the highest concentration of Mark Hamill in any videogame, would be getting a remaster. Producer Jim Vessella is heading up the project, and revealed it during a presentation at the Portland Retro Gaming Expo.

What he did not reveal, it turns out, is that five other Wing Commander games—plus Road Rash—would be getting their own dolled-up re-releases, and that they'd all be dropping on Steam , GOG, and the EA App today as part of a larger bundle of 25 "EA Classics". No, I don't know why you'd buy them on the EA App either. It takes all sorts to make a world.
Here's the full list of games that are dropping. Anything labelled "Anniversary Edition" is an updated, remastered version of the original game. Anything not labelled that is simply a re-release.

If you're a GOG user, the only new things on that storefront will be the remasters—GOG's had all the other classic games for yonks now, but on Steam it's a veritable deluge of hearty, classic stuff . Personally, I'll just be glad to have a copy of Theme Hospital where all my other games are. And if someone fancies turning on Workshop support for it and integrating CorsixTH , they won't hear any objections from me.

On the remaster front, EA pinky promises it hasn't mucked the games up. "Each Anniversary Edition preserves the original look, feel and creative intent of the game, with quality-of-life updates to support modern systems, controls, improve performance and make the titles more approachable without compromising their authenticity."

You know what? I'm inclined to believe it. Vessella, who's more or less become the face of EA's old-game preservation and restoration efforts, also had a big hand in the work on the Command and Conquer Remastered Collection, and that was rather excellent even without access to the source footage of those games' FMV cutscenes, which seems to not be an issue here.

EA says the remasters are the fruit of "the discovery of a physical media vault containing thousands of Betacam, VHS, and D1 tapes alongside other media assets", while "the digitization process recovered the supposedly lost Master FMV sequences for these seven legendary titles, which were meticulously re-edited to restore the over 1,500 cinematic scenes across these games".

items.summary: The National Toy Hall of Fame has officially announced this year’s inductees, and the biggest TCG of all time

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/05/pokemonmuseum-1793897763176.jpg
The National Toy Hall of Fame has officially announced this year’s inductees, and one of the biggest trading card games of all time has finally made the cut.

Pokémon cards were inducted into the Toy Hall of Fame on the morning of Thursday, November 5, as the franchise celebrates its 30th anniversary. Other new additions from this year’s lineup include Bingo, Care Bears, and the classic slide, which beat out nominees like Bop It!, mahjong, and Polly Pocket.

"Pokémon TCG’s widespread appeal and global presence are undeniable," said curator Mirek Stolee. "The Pokémon TCG successfully adapted card game formulas established by its predecessors, making it more accessible and infusing it with the lovable Pokémon creatures."

The National Toy Hall of Fame was established in 1998 to "recognize toys that have inspired creative play and enjoyed popularity over a sustained period." The Hall of Fame is currently housed at the Strong Museum of Play in Rochester, New York, which is also home to the World Video Game Hall of Fame.

Anyone can nominate a toy for consideration. A panel of museum curators, historians, and educators then evaluate these nominees based on four pillars: icon status, longevity, discovery, and innovation. The Hall of Fame has a relatively loose definition of a toy, having previously inducted a cardboard box and the concept of 'sand' in addition to classics like LEGO, Barbies, and slinkies.

This isn’t the first time a trading card game has made it onto the prestigious toy list. Magic: The Gathering was added in 2019, nearly 10 years after the induction of another tabletop classic, Dungeons & Dragons .
The Strong website now has a section dedicated to the Pokémon TCG , where it describes the game’s history and cultural impact:

"[Pokémon TCG] has played a pivotal role in popularizing the concept of trading card games and has served as an entryway into the hobby for millions. The Pokémon TCG has even spawned its own video game (for Game Boy) and app (available on multiple platforms), thus completing the circle back to its video game origins. Recently, the cards have become the focus of major financial speculation. Online viewers watch content creators “rip,” or open, TCG packs, in the hope of finding valuable, rare cards."

As of March 2026, more than 85 billion Pokémon cards have been printed and distributed globally. The trading card game is currently being printed in 13 different languages, and rough estimates put the total market cap above $15 billion.

As the museum description implies, however, the massive explosion of Pokémon’s popularity hasn’t really been a good thing for most fans. Scalping has plagued the community for years now, turning the once casual card game hobby into a collector’s racket. Market prices have soared out of control , threatening the 'accessibility' the Toy Hall of Fame specifically praises the game for.

The Pokémon Company is aware of the problem, and has repeatedly announced its intentions to increase stock to combat it. This increased production seems to have taken effect with the recent 30th anniversary product line, which led to scalpers complaining the set isn't profitable enough.
As for the Hall of Fame, Pokémon’s induction will likely lead to new exhibits and events at The Strong in the new year.

items.summary: World of Warcraft Forever launched last night, and while there were a ton of people playing, the servers were

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/03/wowthumb-1793742518107.png

World of Warcraft Forever launched last night, and while there were a ton of people playing, the servers were remarkably stable . It turns out that Blizzard dedicated a ton of resources to making sure those servers were solid.

Last night, after the game launched, Blizzard tweeted out a meme from its World of Warcraft account, with a Gnome tapping a car with the WoW Forever logo, with a caption saying: "*Slaps Roof of WoW: Forever* This baby is running on: 3,924 Virtual Machines, 251,136 GB of Memory, 70,480 CPU Cores." That's a huge amount of memory, and it seems to have paid off with the smoothest Blizzard launch I've seen in years.

Blizzard's post bragging about the sheer amount of memory in its servers comes just a week after Sam Altman said in a podcast that it was "quite terrible" for people to have RAM in their own computers, rather than in a data center. Of course, he did later walk it back , instead claiming that he had "been arguing for the world to ramp up memory production for a long time." Still, that's 251,136GB of RAM that's dedicated to running an incredible MMO, rather than powering yet another data center.
*Slaps Roof of WoW: Forever* This baby is running on: 3,924 Virtual Machines 251,136 GB of Memory 70,480 CPU Cores https://t.co/P9PdRBzke7

Blizzard Executive Producer and Vice President for World of Warcraft Holly Longdale also posted celebrating the smooth launch, and said "this launch was crazier than the insanity we imagined but thankfully the team built plans and contingencies. They are incredible imo." And, while we likely will never know just how many people logged into Forever for the launch, I can say firsthand that there were hundreds of characters in the starting zone right at 6pm EST, so the team definitely deserves recognition for holding everything together.

Even on the WoW forums, which are hardly a bastion of positivity, there are a number of threads with players praising WoW Forever for being one of the smoothest WoW launches of all time . On X/Twitter, WoW streamer Darth Microtransaction posted, "I don’t know how they did it, but they did. World of Warcraft Forever launch was the smoothest launch I’ve seen. Almost 0 Que[ue]. 0 dc, and no lag."

This launch was a solid start to a game that's going to take most people weeks to go through. The beta was huge on its own, despite being limited to just level 30. And, even when folks knew their characters would get deleted, so many people played the beta that developers commented on it for being the "craziest numbers [they've] seen." And now that the full game is here, it's going to be interesting to see what players discover, and what gets added in the future. Because, according to Blizzard, there's potential to visit some fan favorite locations from future expansions , too.

items.title: 《幻影之刃零》评测：感觉好感，而不是好感
items.summary: A martial arts action epic with just a dash of Souls and Sekiro.

content.v: What is it A martial arts action epic Release date October 28, 2026 Expect to pay £49.99/$59.99 Publisher S-Game Developer S-Game Reviewed on Intel Core i5 12400F, Radeon RX 6800 XT, 32GB RAM, Multiplayer No Steam Deck Unsupported Link Steam

Ever since I started Phantom Blade Zero , I've had a scene from Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon playing on repeat in my head. It's the sequence when Jen and Shu Lien face-off against each other in the martial arts hall. Jen is wielding the Green Destiny, a sword which can seemingly slice through all other weapons, but as it does, Shu Lien adapts.

She uses blades, spears, hook swords, a metal club, but every weapon she picks up, she immediately wields with martial prowess—it might be a bit of a wuxia trope, but it can't help but encapsulate the experience of playing Phantom Blade Zero. The protagonist, Soul's old comrade, Lei Dang, echoes this sentiment when you meet him: "You truly are a martial prodigy - you can master anything you learn."

In a crowded market of action games often borrowing more from Souls and Sekiro than they rightly should, Phantom Blade Zero sheds these strictures in favour of a martial arts adventure that's more about feeling good than getting good. It's not just the endless array of weapons and Phantom Edges (essentially Sekiro's Shinobi Tools) that Soul wields with effortless martial grace, it's about how the game makes you feel like a master.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/n7npBZSmhUx2Gfa8fcVQ4k-1920-80.jpg

Phantom Blade Zero managed to convince me—a Dark Souls veteran with 860 hours in Elden Ring—that perhaps you don't have to struggle against bosses to make them meaningful. Maybe a fight or two is enough when a game is packed full of incredible boss battles, each encounter feels great, and the experience is epic enough to satisfy you that you've seen everything it had to show.
Feel gud

Phantom Blade Zero is really a game for those who revel in action combat and its spectacle, but that's not to say it's super easy—it just has a way of making you feel like you're better than you probably are. During one fight with a drunken swordmaster and his flying blade, I parried and Soul dropped onto his back, grabbed the blade between his feet, then forward flipped, hurling the sword back at the boss. I literally pressed one button to do this.
Not to say it's super easy—it just has a way of making you feel like you're better than you probably are.

There are so many jaw-dropping moments—elaborate parries and executions, or dynamic attacks where Soul automatically engages an entire group of enemies—that basically had me yelling at the screen because I couldn't believe what I'd just pulled off. Like any good kung-fu movie, it's effortlessly stylish, but rather than the all-too-familiar drudgery that can stem from Soulslikes crushing you into the dirt and making you feel your skill level, Phantom Blade Zero more often tries to uplift you, reveling in the roleplay fantasy of a martial master.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cnryaCnqsGFmQ47rCiPZ2T-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZPd3ALueGZNkmNZ4gCKA2T-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hBQDX3jA7pXLKaMDpER22T-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4nA8yjPLJU5QrJ9QCyrTmb-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/sfbQbCktZ3WscRnBnXh2fS-1920-80.jpg

It also makes the wuxia genre feel approachable. I'd be the first to admit, even as a westerner relatively familiar with Chinese mythology, I struggled to understand what was happening in Black Myth Wukong a lot of time. By comparison, Phantom Blade is a classic revenge plot. Soul, a martially-gifted orphan of mysterious providence, now outlaw, travels to the town of Pangzhen to confront his sworn brother and betrayer, Zuo Shang, after they stabbed each other through the heart. His replacement, The Tainted Heart, only lasts 66 days, so he has to beat Zuo Shang to the prize, a rumoured artificial heart, hence the top difficulty's fun and loreful limitation of 66 lives.

Though its dialogue is a bit on the nose at times, Phantom Blade does a great job of gradually exposing its ill-fated characters, dark setting, and sorrowful story of martial sects grasping to harness unearthly powers. It also carries forward Black Myth Wukong's tendency to surprise you with cutscenes of different styles, including Chinese shadow puppetry.
Coupled with its dark story, it makes for a far dirtier version of wuxia.

It's most adept at teasing its bosses, though, by telling their stories through found notes and Memory Flower collectibles in each region, or via Dark Souls 3 opening-style cinematics. Coupled with its dark story, it makes for a far dirtier version of wuxia, channeling aspects of kung-fu and wild west cinema as we see roundtables of fated standoffs with tragic foes we're yet to face.
Soul-like

Phantom Blade Zero is demonstrably not a Soulslike—hell, it's even less of one than Black Myth Wukong was. Though it has the recognisable structure of bells (bonfires) and remnant echoes (souls), it does away with almost everything else, much to its benefit.

This makes for an action game with a lot more momentum. Rather than banging your head against the same boss ten times, you might fight three or more bosses in the same period—Phantom Blade clearly understands that the spectacle of boss battles is one of the core pillars of a great action game, so there are a lot of them with varied gimmicks.
The game also takes notes from Sekiro, but mechanically responds to two of its, arguably, most debated issues. Namely:

Attacking, deflecting, and parrying to break a boss's stamina in Phantom Blade doesn't give you a critical attack, but instead grants a period in which they can't block your assault. This encourages experimentation, and ultimately, allows you to style on a boss however you wish for the duration. Being aggressive, versus baiting out parries, is encouraged, since regular attacks don't consume stamina and without crits, you have to progressively deal damage to win the fight.

Familiarising yourself with Phantom Blade's massive array of Phantom Edges (the Shinobi Tool equivalent) is also incentivised, since they use a spark resource you get a set number of anytime you rest, but can also recoup through accessories and skills. I personally used the gigantic Dread Axe to smash opponents, and the Fire Meteor, a brazier of green flame on a chain that you kick around to ignite enemies. There are also shields, bows, throwing knives, cannons, guns, spike balls and chains, bashpoles, and even summon options, to name a few.

What's more, since weapons and Phantom Edges gain new abilities every five levels, (up to 30), and Phantom Blade is extremely generous with upgrade materials, letting you easily refund everything you put into them, you're always experimenting. I feel like it says something that I upgraded four weapons and two Phantom Edges fully in my playthrough, yet still had 3 million remnant echoes and the means to level far more.
Good thing, too, considering I have another 20 weapons and 22 Phantom Edges to master in my New Game+ run.
Quest easy

I only have one chief complaint with Phantom Blade Zero. Though the game is quite large—it took me 50ish hours to do everything and unlock the "true" ending—it's unfortunately rather hand-holdy when it comes to its secrets, meticulously guiding you through the game with an almost exhausting quantity of quests and map markers.

items.summary: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it'll only be a few steps removed from

content.v: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it'll only be a few steps removed from reality when it launches this month. Actions have consequences , working on a relationship requires more than just hitting a few button prompts, and bulking up means that you'll have to visit an in-game gym regularly. Will all of that add up to an experience that can give a little dude in green a run for his money as the best-reviewed game of the year ? Who knows, but what I do know is that Rockstar Games better have some hygiene options in the game, because Jason's gym etiquette is disgusting .
Maybe I'm reading too much into this, but amongst the dozens of new GTA 6 screenshots released today, there's this one of Jason pumping iron:
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/GTA-6-launch-screens-22.jpg?w=636

While I keep telling myself that comparison is the thief of joy and that I shouldn't compare the few strands of muscle fiber I have next to a digital character who looks like he curls Jack Reacher actors for a morning routine, I also can't help but find myself repulsed by Jason's lack of hygiene.

I'm also told that Miami--the city that GTA 6's location of Vice City is inspired by--is hot as hell, but that's still no excuse to not be wearing any gym clothing up top. Hell, even if it's one of those gym tank tops with spaghetti straps, that's still better than nothing, because I cannot imagine how much disinfectant you'd need to clean up that rack when Jason is done with it.

There's no sign of a sweat towel either, so you just know there's going to be a rank puddle of perspiration waiting for the next unlucky person who uses it. Revolting . Maybe it's his home gym, but that's still no excuse to work out in this state. Sure, maybe he's the only person who uses that facility, but I bet you the nearby NPCs are going to smell it from across the block.

Am I reading too much into this? Absolutely. But if Rockstar can spend several years agonizing over the most minute details for its new Grand Theft Auto experience, then as someone who is potentially thinking of dropping $80 on it, I'm allowed to obsess over seeing a jacked-up protagonist turn the rack into a breeding ground of bacterial infections on par with a Resident Evil campaign. There are all kinds of escapism that I'm expecting from GTA 6, but poor gym hygiene certainly isn't one of them.
I was fine with weaponized dog poop , but bareback bench presses are where I draw the line.
